messages:
alex: Quick check — KR (seoul) cutover scheduled Fri 03:00 UTC. Need routing/QoS + KMS/data residency signoff. Who owns egress routing and peering changes?

mona: I can own egress routing and peering updates. Will need NLB config + route policies from platform.

liam: KMS / key provisioning lives with security but I'll coordinate. yasmin do you want the key alias prefixed with customer or region?

yasmin: prefer region-prefixed: r-seoul-<env>-redwood-kms. Also need a compliance checklist for logs leaving region — who owns that?

alex: ops-oncall owns runbook + smoke tests. mona will PR NLB change, liam = KMS key request, yasmin = compliance signoff.

devex-bot: Deploy bot triggered: generation of preflight checklist started -> https://go/redwood/infrachecks/3105556789

ops-oncall: I'll write the runbook snippet. Basic smoke test I use: ```bash
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TEST' "https://kr-seoul-api.redwood-inference.com/health" | jq .status
```

mona: PR opened: https://go/repo/pull/4582 — changes: add seoul nlb, new routing policy tag 'region=kr-seoul', qos egress class. cc @liam for KMS env var name.

liam: noted. I'll file KMS request now. Also flag: DB replica promotion window is 15m, plan to do read-only switch 03:05-03:20 UTC. If any long-running jobs, kill or postpone.

yasmin: Compliance: need to disable analytics export for seoul region for first 30 days and confirm audit logs routed to EU-logs bucket w/ restricted ACLs. I'll send required checklist items by EOD.

alex: Great. Action items summary: 1) mona -> merge PR #4582 and coordinate NLB change (ETA Thu EOD) 2) liam -> KMS key + env vars (ETA Thu EOD) 3) ops-oncall -> runbook + smoke tests (ETA Thu EOD) 4) yasmin -> compliance checklist (ETA Thu EOD) 5) alex -> run cutover window and monitor 03:00-03:30 Fri.

mona: I'll add the merge hold with the canary flag, will schedule staged rollout to avoid global churn.

ops-oncall: I'll add runbook to runbooks/regions/kr-seoul.md and post link when ready.

liam: KMS request submitted (REQ-9221). Once approved I'll post the key ARN here.

yasmin: Posted checklist: https://go/compliance/seoul-checklist. Two blockers noted: analytics export + third-party backups. We need thumbs up from product for backup exception.

alex: tagging @product for backup exception later. For now, everyone please react with :thumbsup: when your ETA is firm. I'll do a final preflight at 02:30 UTC Fri.

mona: :thumbsup:

liam: :thumbsup:

yasmin: :thumbsup:
